title: Components of the twisted unit/Chern splitting
statement: For a Presentation p of a Noetherian projective-line model f:X→S, l invertible on S, every finite evaluation of p.model.bq is invertible. Let T be positive twisting followed by shift 2, a:line(S)[2]≅T(unit(S)) the positive-unit comparison, b:T(inverseLine(S)[-2])≅unit(S) the shift-cancellation and dual-line contraction comparison, and w:T(Rf_*unit(X))≅Rf_*(line(X)[2]) the projection comparison. Then twistedUnit=a.hom≫T(inl)≫T(bq)≫w.hom and chernAdjoint=b.inv≫T(inr)≫T(bq)≫w.hom. These are identities before inverting bq; no trace normalization is asserted.

source.place: paragraph (1), components of the twisted unit/chern splitting

proof.text: Apply diagonalTrace_finite_splitting separately at every finite positive level.

The section-normalized positive pullback square at the coefficient unit identifies the unit component. Naturality of the positive comparison and the adjunction triangle identity give projection_mate_unit. The canonical derived adjunction respects shifts, so adjoint_shift identifies the shifted adjunct. Finally biprod.inl_desc gives the stated first component.

Use the cocycle and unit coherence of exact localization to derive the inverse-twist triangle from the ordinary equivalence triangle (derived_inverse_triangle). Naturality of commShiftIso and shiftFunctorCompIsoId gives retwist_shift. Combining the inverse-twist triangle with counit naturality gives retwist_inverse, which applies directly to Model.second. The identity biprod.inr_desc then proves the Chern component.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (1); explicit categorical mate and inverse-twist assembly

theorem diagonalTrace_twistedSplitting_components
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S]
    {f : X ⟶ S} (p : Presentation l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f)
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) :
    let E := ULift.{u} (Padic l)
    let T := p.twistS.T l E ⋙ shiftFunctor (D S (Arings l E S)) (2 : ℤ)
    let a := (shiftFunctor (D S (Arings l E S)) (2 : ℤ)).mapIso
      (p.twistS.positiveUnit l E).symm
    let b := (shiftFunctor (D S (Arings l E S)) (2 : ℤ)).mapIso
        (((p.twistS.T l E).commShiftIso (-2 : ℤ)).app (inverseLine l E p.chernS)) ≪≫
      (shiftFunctorCompIsoId (D S (Arings l E S)) (-2 : ℤ) 2 (by decide)).app
        ((p.twistS.T l E).obj (inverseLine l E p.chernS)) ≪≫
      p.twistS.contract l E
    (∀ n : ℕ, IsIso ((SpTowerShriek.Ev l E S n).map (p.model.bq l E))) ∧
      p.model.twistedUnit l E =
        a.hom ≫ T.map biprod.inl ≫ T.map (p.model.bq l E) ≫
          (p.model.twistedPush l E).hom ∧
      p.model.chernAdjoint l E =
        b.inv ≫ T.map biprod.inr ≫ T.map (p.model.bq l E) ≫
          (p.model.twistedPush l E).hom
